content.title: Chipmos: Q1 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HSINCHU, Taiwan (AP) — Chipmos Technologies Ltd. (IMOS) on Tuesday reported profit of $5.3 million in its first quarter. On a per-share basis, the Hsinchu, Taiwan-based company said it had net income of 15 cents. The computer chip testing and assembly services company posted revenue of $166.7 million in the period.
